title: Folk Melody
body: Folk melodies are meant to be memorable: strong opening note, clear shape, easy to sing. This one is in G major — watch for the leaps of a 4th and 5th that give it its open, outdoor feeling.

title: The Opening Leap
caption: The melody starts with G then leaps up to D — a perfect fifth. This interval sounds open and resolved. Bar 2 descends stepwise back to G, completing the first phrase.
